data.name: Command the Field
data.description: You can create a telekinetic field around yourself or a target within 30 ft. and make the immediate vicinity hard to navigate.  The target's square and all squares within %1 ft. are considered to be difficult terrain for %2 rounds.  You can dismiss this effect as a free action. This effect does not move with the target and you are not affected by the difficult terrain of the effect.  You can use this ability %3/day.|CommandTheFieldRadius|CommandTheFieldDuration|CommandTheFieldTimes
